sections.body: 湖南 · 张家界武陵源
武陵源位于湖南，以砂岩峰柱、深谷与林木交织的山地景观闻名。1992 年，武陵源风景名胜区被列入《世界遗产名录》。
sections.heading: 在地故事

sections.body: 先看峰林的整体轮廓，再看石柱之间的空隙。拍照时留一点天空和远山，让山势的层次进入画面。

sections.body: Hunan · Wulingyuan, Zhangjiajie
Wulingyuan in Hunan is known for sandstone pillars, wooded slopes and deep valleys. The scenic area joined the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1992.
sections.heading: PLACE

sections.body: Start with the outline of the peaks, then notice the spaces between them. Leave some sky and distant hills in the frame to hold the depth of the landscape.
